# Historical paper examples

These 15 archives preserve listings that were changed or removed when the
paper adopted partial function types and strict term checking. Their filenames
and `#former-paper` tags retain the old listing numbers. Programs and assertions
are preserved; the evaluator runs executable cases alongside the current
[paper corpus](../paper/). Expected failures reflect the new checking rules.

`paper.cue.txt` records the former text, not a listing in the current paper.
The former incremental algorithm is retained as non-executable pseudocode.
